scope_note: Peru is a coastal cluster with TWO natural short-hop sub-networks that never chain into one run: (1) the Lima/Callao metro coast (La Punta peninsula + the offshore Callao islands + the Costa Verde marinas + Ancon bay to the north), and (2) the Paracas bay 130+ nm south (El Chaco jetty + the Ballestas marine reserve). Current density is thin (2 cities, 1 anchor BP). Deepen both with real sourced boarding points and clean offshore-island corridors.
no_invention_rule: Every BP is a real named pier/marina/island with a source URL. Grok does deterministic ID-match + coords + seal.
hazards_global: The Callao islands sit in open Pacific off a naval base (Isla San Lorenzo / El Fronton are naval/restricted on land) - routes are water-only island approaches, never landings on restricted islands. Humboldt swell on the Costa Verde: keep offshore of the surf line. Callao<->Paracas (~130 nm) is FAR beyond N30 range - two separate clusters, never one corridor.

boarding_point_candidates.name: La Punta Bay pier (Callao)
boarding_point_candidates.note: La Punta peninsula bay; primary yacht/excursion boarding point for the Callao islands.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Darsena Pier (Plaza Grau, Callao)
boarding_point_candidates.note: Muelle Darsena at Plaza Grau; departure point for Palomino Islands tours.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Marina Club / Nautical Club Pier (Callao)
boarding_point_candidates.note: Nautical Club pier alternative departure for the Callao island runs.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Lima Marina Club (Chorrillos, Costa Verde)
boarding_point_candidates.note: Lima's exclusive seafront marina at Chorrillos on the Costa Verde; also Club de Regatas Lima adjacency.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Marina & Yacht Club Ancon
boarding_point_candidates.note: 60-year-old yacht club in Ancon bay ~35 km north of Lima; sheltered bay resort. Also Yacht Club Ancon (Wikipedia).

offshore_islands.name: Isla San Lorenzo
offshore_islands.note: Largest Peruvian island, ~3 nm off La Punta; water approach only.

offshore_islands.name: Palomino Islands (via El Fronton / Cavinzas)
offshore_islands.note: Sea-lion colony ~8 nm off Callao; passes El Fronton and Cavinzas reserve.

corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Depart La Punta bay westward into open water; approach San Lorenzo's north/east shore. Stay clear (offshore) of the naval base and restricted island land.
Route past El Fronton and Cavinzas as water waypoints; do not land on restricted islands. Open-Pacific swell - offshore approach.
Coastal run NW along the Costa Verde cliff shore (Barranco/Miraflores/Magdalena) into Callao bay; keep offshore of the surf line.
Coastal run N past the Pasamayo cliffs; offshore waypoint to clear the headland before entering Ancon bay. Range-OK one-way; verify duty cycle.

new_city.name: Pisco / San Andres
new_city.note: Fishing port + San Andres jetty just N of Paracas inside Pisco/Paracas bay.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Paracas (El Chaco) jetty
boarding_point_candidates.note: El Chaco boardwalk jetty; main embarkation for the Ballestas within the sheltered Paracas Bay.

boarding_point_candidates.name: San Andres pier (Pisco)
boarding_point_candidates.note: Fishing-village pier N of Paracas inside the bay.

offshore_islands.name: Ballestas Islands
offshore_islands.note: Marine-reserve rock islands ~9 nm off El Chaco; guano/sea-lion/penguin colony - water approach only, no landing.

corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Exit Paracas Bay NW past the Paracas peninsula, then open-water approach to the Ballestas; no landing (protected reserve).
Short protected run inside Paracas/Pisco bay.

excluded_context_only.reason: ~130 nm >> N30 70 nm range. Two distinct clusters.
